report.summary: Chunk 4 of 4: defines run_checks and with_markers functions for check execution and policy modification.

handoff.purpose: Define run_checks and with_markers functions for check execution and policy modification.

symbols.name: run_checks
symbols.note: Runs baseline and extra checks, returns empty string if all pass, otherwise returns refusal reason. Fail-closed: exceptions caught and return refusal.

symbols.name: with_markers
symbols.note: Returns a new CheckPolicy with elision_markers replaced by given markers.

claims.text: Run the baseline, then any lane-specific additions. "" means write it.
claims.why: The function iterates over BASELINE and extra, and returns "" if no check returns a reason.

claims.text: FAIL-CLOSED, and this is the part worth not losing: a check that raises is reported as a refusal naming the crash.
claims.why: Exception is caught and returns a string with exception info, thus refusing the write.

claims.text: A lane may pass ``extra`` to ADD checks. There is deliberately no argument for removing one from the baseline.
claims.why: Function accepts extra Iterable[Check] and adds to BASELINE; no removal argument exists.

claims.text: ``policy`` with this lane's own elision markers. Convenience only.

observations.what: run_checks returns str, empty string means success, non-empty means refusal.
with_markers uses replace from dataclasses (implied) to create new policy.
